summary: Moodle is an open source learning management system designed to host and manage online courses. It provides a structured environment for educators to publish learning materials and track student progress.
goodFor: It suits organisations and educators who need a customisable, community-supported platform to deliver online courses and educational content.
watchOut: As an educational platform with a large feature set, it can present a significant configuration and maintenance overhead for administrators.
deployNotes: Hosting typically requires a standard PHP stack with a relational database like MySQL or PostgreSQL, alongside persistent storage for user uploads and course files.
